triage_r2.rationale: One high-severity finding remains: bench pacing makes the page about 3x the approved sketch, and phones are worse. Several medium items are real and fixable inside their areas: the mobile lane panel collision, the /Portfolio build check, the nav marker on case pages, background traces behind text, and an undiscoverable trigger. The "Skip intro" cue is not a fix. Skip-on-gesture already exists, and the intro is about 2.5s, so the "5s" claim is overstated. The intro timing tweak is kept small. The 1.0:1 button and 1.3:1 lane-label detector flags are false positives and are logged as such. Retired-pattern items (the route tiles and the node-and-rail timeline) and the board physicality are kept at medium or low. Fixes that need edits outside an area are folded into the area that owns the file.

fix:scene:r2.summary:
Fixed the medium issue where background traces ran through dense copy and controls. Each section now has an ambient level, set in pageMap.ts with measureQuiet() and the constants QUIET_TRACE=0.4, QUIET_PAPER=0.55, QUIET_FEATHER=32px and MAX_QUIET=8. A screen section is quiet when it has data-ambient="quiet"; without that attribute, #work and #stack are quiet by default (data-ambient="full" turns it off). Any other element inside #main can also mark itself data-ambient="quiet". A section's quiet zone starts just under its visible h2 (8px of overlap for descenders) and ends at the section's content box. That leaves the section header, the side gutters (the px-margin padding) and the section's top and bottom padding at full strength. Zones are measured on resize and when #main changes size (for example when the bench expands), never per frame.

WebGL path: a shared GLSL quietMask()/ambient() function takes up to 8 zone rects in viewport device px, with a soft edge 32px wide centred on each border. In the trace vertex shader, trace amplitude (the parked lanes, Σ and the section-edge trace) is multiplied by the ambient level at the lane centre, so waves flatten to about 40% behind copy. In the composite shader, trace brightness drops to 40% (applied after persistence, so trails dim too) and the page graticule drops to 55%. ScopeCanvas converts zones from document to viewport coordinates each frame, and only zones in view are uploaded. The static path (reduced motion, no WebGL, lit
openIssues: Datasheet body: the scope is mounted only on the home page (src/app/page.tsx), so /work/[slug] pages have no traces to dim and no change was needed there. If the scope is ever mounted on datasheet pages, mark the body with data-ambient="quiet" (or the section with data-surface="screen" data-ambient="quiet") and the same mechanism applies.
Optional, for other areas: any dense block in another screen section (for example a contact form, if one is added) can opt in with data-ambient="quiet" on its wrapper. No change is required now.

The section scroll offsets in the fix evidence (y06898, y13796) no longer match because other agents changed the page height during the run. Verification used the same content (the bench left column and the Stack intro) at their current offsets.
